summary_1line: Before gods and sages, Sita proves her fidelity and is received by the Earth goddess, descending into the earth as the assembly watches in awe.

image_candidates.scene_text: From the ground rises a radiant throne borne on the jeweled heads of mighty Nagas as the Earth goddess lifts Sita into her arms.
Sita in a yellow robe stands with folded hands before the vast assembly of gods, sages, and kings as a fragrant wind sweeps the sacrificial ground.
Flower petals rain from the sky while Sita seated on the celestial throne slowly sinks back into the earth before the stunned assembly.
